design.normalization: Only trailing whitespace stripped; six Markdown hard line breaks in the metadata header. Normative wording unchanged.

domains.inspect: PLAYER/ENTITY/BLOCK/LOCATION/WORLD owner-thread snapshot; protected entity classification
domains.planned_actions: heal, nonlethal damage, kill, effects, freeze/fire, velocity, teleport, AI, invulnerability, gamemode/flight, target, remove, block data, effects, time/weather, sandbox stack
domains.canonical_route: Bukkit owner scheduler; teleportAsync; manager-owned entities excluded from generic remove
domains.rationale: WW-02 implements owner-routed immutable vanilla snapshots, canonical material/gamemode catalogs, location Thread export and recipient-only cosmetic feedback through the generic kernel/GUI. Full vanilla manipulation, influence consumers, journal and live interaction evidence remain open; initial provider registration is not domain acceptance.

domains.inspect: authoritative instance, behavior state, sessions, receipts, diagnostics
domains.planned_actions: recover, clear session, arming, vanish, Thread/Imprint/Binding/Fork controls
domains.canonical_route: Generalize existing DevItemManager; preserve Bingulus pending/pity; HiddenDevAuthority; ModerationManager + VanishManager
domains.rationale: The existing artifact lifecycle now binds the generic kernel/GUI, session/arming/Thread/history state and fail-closed non-durable execution. Neutral reward-policy and influence/quarantine data foundations exist; actual Self provider, persistent influence, complete reward integration, bindings/forks and connected-client acceptance remain open.

domains.planned_actions: force_ability, add/remove ability, rank/archetype/template projection, refresh, export/import, fork
domains.canonical_route: MobAbilityRuntime.triggerTechnique/startCast; canonical registry enumeration; separate MobRuntimeProjectionSource consumer
domains.rationale: WW-04 binds journal-backed provider-owned combat projection and native one-shot control routes. Ability/rank/archetype/template projection, compatible Thread import, conditional sever/Undo, typed projection selection/clear and observed crash recovery are implemented behind the closed gameplay integrity gate. Force ability uses native eligibility/cast/telegraph/cooldown/target checks; refresh reconciles current registry definitions without resetting cooldowns. A bounded native operation ledger supports observation without replay; missing generation after detach/restart requires review. Canonical rank/level/loot/Bestiary identities remain unchanged. Cross-region cast/effect completion, AREA/context/stat consumers, reward producer/propagation integration and populated native/client evidence remain required; full PvE coverage is not claimed.

domains.inspect: canonical/effective membership; passive/food/target decision; civilian access and DARK prerequisite traces
domains.planned_actions: project faction, contexts, scripted target/peace through existing policy, canonical membership
domains.canonical_route: FactionManager.adjustMembershipDurably / PlayerProfileFactionStore exact revision WAL; native role-cleanup outbox; FactionPassivePolicy and SinManager preserve independent legal and reward identity
domains.rationale: Effective membership/context projections feed the existing passive/target policy with typed imports and journal-backed conditional sever. LIVE_GM-only canonical set/remove now use the native revision-checked profile transaction and acknowledged role-cleanup outbox, with owner-routed generic actions and observed restart recovery. Exile, Oath and immutable history remain independent. Scripted target/peace controls and populated native evidence remain required; full domain acceptance is not claimed.

domains.planned_actions: individualize, activate, transition, repair, sandbox copy, four rule field kinds, export/import, fork
domains.canonical_route: TrashHistoryService owns markers and read-only item inspection; native history/anomaly stores fence mutation/save as well as inspection after uncertain writes until successful load assessment. TrashRuleFieldService owns bounded fields and claims. Native projectile-wall consumption requires verified co-ownership and never freezes before acknowledgement; recoverable cross-region completion and influence admission remain unimplemented. Shared Anomaly/Relic activation extraction is required before provider mutation registration.
domains.rationale: The registered Trash inspection subset reads native identity/history/provenance, derives archaeology without awards, reports actual runtime memory and world-local fields; dynamic identity/rule catalogs use canonical registries. Full Trash remains an implementation blocker: shared activation APIs, all developer mutation actions, journal/recovery, prototype/influence admission, and projectile handoff/unload/disable hardening are unfinished. Read-only subset registration does not waive domain coverage or connected runtime evidence.

domains.planned_actions: developer unlock/level/insight/reset using existing domain service with expected revision
domains.canonical_route: TrashArchaeologyService.inspect/unlock/setLevel/addInsight/reset -> Profile CAS
domains.rationale: Existing hidden mutation route has no WorldWeaver receipt/revision fence. DEV_PROTOTYPED provenance must remain excluded from natural facts and progression.

domains.inspect: territory, shape, protection decision trace, regeneration pending blocks
domains.planned_actions: DENY sandbox overlay; ALLOW LIVE_GM; canonical rename/type/owner/Y bounds; overlay fork
domains.canonical_route: TerritoryManager.adjustConditionally via TerritoryCanonicalActions on AsyncIoOwner after durable PREPARED; observed native receipts, fingerprint/revision admission and compensating transactions. TerritoryProtectionService consumes journal overlays only.
domains.rationale: Registered provider supplies world-owned dynamic catalogs, Thread, bound protection projection, conditional Undo and four native LIVE_GM transactions; local player/entity/block/location facets expose owner-captured zone metadata and the native protection decision trace. Native receipts publish after atomic persistence; recovery observes real state without replay and compensation preserves history. SANDBOX ALLOW and sever revealing ALLOW are rejected. Overlay Fork, generic local-to-world navigation and connected native evidence remain required before FULL_PROVIDER.

domains.inspect: claims, trusted players, dimensions/footprint, build decision
domains.planned_actions: bounded trust/untrust/unclaim and claim operations via manager conditional API
domains.canonical_route: ClaimManager claimSelection/claimPolygon/extendClaim/trust/untrust/adminUnclaimAt
domains.rationale: Currency and overlapping territory protection participate in claim changes. Existing player-oriented calls require expected footprint/revision and durable observed-state recovery, not raw map editing.

domains.planned_actions: prototype clone/reroll/ascend/runes; canonical reroll/ascend/runes/signature with explicit safe domain route; presentation refresh
domains.canonical_route: ItemMutationCoordinator and ItemMutationJournal; ItemMutationService; ItemIdentityService
domains.rationale: Existing coordinator owns physical slot, cost, recovery and render. Need expected-slot/fingerprint/revision developer entry without reward receipt spoofing; prototype exclusion across all item consumers.

domains.inspect: class/spec/talents/resources/cooldowns and sealed specialization cause; effective DARK healing multiplier
domains.planned_actions: conditional class/spec/doctrine/talent/xp/grants; bounded runtime resource/cooldown adjustments; favorites
domains.canonical_route: SpecializationManager / class-spec runtime; ClassHealthService and SpellHealingUtil canonical healing route
domains.rationale: PR #155 centralizes DARK healing and introduces missing-Oath specialization seal. Both are current projection consumers to audit; WorldWeaver must not bypass them through direct heal/slot writes.

domains.planned_actions: conditional profession selection/clear/XP/learned recipe adjustments and blueprint prototype
domains.canonical_route: ProfessionManager select/set/clear/setXp/addXp/learnRecipe -> conditional PROFESSION section
domains.rationale: Existing mutations are asynchronous but do not carry the WW snapshot expected revision. Gathering/crafting/fishing/weekly/class hooks must carry RewardContext before any progression.

domains.inspect: wallet/currency supply/exchange/shop/faucet receipt and pending state
domains.planned_actions: LIVE_GM conditional balance adjustment/compensation; sandbox currency visual prototype; safe board controls
domains.canonical_route: CurrencyManager durable wallet/creditOnce/apply/rollback; immutable receipt identities retained
domains.rationale: Faucets and transfers share wallet API. Gate the originating faucet with context; denying every credit would strand previously legitimate settlement. Physical currency/prototype paths must be fenced.

domains.planned_actions: bounded cancellation/recovery and conditional listing/donation actions
domains.canonical_route: MarketManager + DonationChestManager canonical transaction/escrow routes
domains.rationale: Other-player assets, bids and pending deliveries cannot be silently overwritten. Need conditional action contract, exact observed-state and compensation; no receipt/history erasure.

domains.planned_actions: sandbox crate demonstration/prototype; armed canonical key/location/stats edits via manager
domains.canonical_route: CrateManager setCrateAsync/removeCrateAsync/buyKeyAsync/giveKeys/requestOpen/resetStatsAsync
domains.rationale: SANDBOX must gate before consuming keys or reserving reward; legitimate pending rewards must not be deleted. Catalog must enumerate crateIds and definitions.

domains.planned_actions: conditional capture/summon/dismiss/select/release/rename/stance/armor/XP; runtime target
domains.canonical_route: PetManager V2 mutations via ClassSpecProfileGateway.mutateCompanion/mutateCompanionProgress
domains.rationale: Pet owner and active entity have separate Folia owners. WW requests need expected profile and entity identity plus taint propagation into pet kills, spawned entities and owner XP.

domains.planned_actions: bounded summon/stance/despawn/totem controls
domains.canonical_route: MinionManager canonical owner ledger; TotemManager placement and clearOwnerProjection; class spell APIs
domains.rationale: No arbitrary entity clone. Parent influence must propagate to all minion/totem/projectile damage and secondary spawn sources.

domains.planned_actions: safe prototype; conditional issue/transfer/reclaim/awakening/cooldown through relic authority
domains.canonical_route: RelicManager lifecycle + ClassRelicService + RelicWorldStateStore
domains.rationale: True relic limit/lost/ownership lifecycle must remain intact. DEV artifact is separate; no cloned owner/receipt/history. Explicit journaled domain commands needed for canonical mutation.

domains.planned_actions: conditional shards/soulforge rank and explicit ritual/pact actions
domains.canonical_route: ClassSpecProfileGateway.mutateSoulShards/incrementSoulforge; RitualManager.tryRitual
domains.rationale: Cost and progression/state transitions must not be simulated via inventory/PDC. Multi-owner summon consequences require influence before effects.

domains.planned_actions: track/abandon; conditional accept/reset/complete-without-reward/discover/achievement/statistics actions after safe domain ports
domains.canonical_route: QuestManager + PlayerProfileQuestStore; BestiaryManager + PlayerProfileAchievementStore; StatsManager; AdvancementService
domains.rationale: Bestiary.record triggers milestone payout; Quest.turnIn reserves/delivers rewards. These are not reward-free developer mutation APIs. Need explicit expected-revision/no-reward paths, preserving pending legitimate receipts.

domains.planned_actions: inspect only; no resurrected procedural-daily progression
domains.canonical_route: DailyQuestManager.getStreak
domains.rationale: Retired procedural daily engine is a historical compatibility view only (source class documentation). No live daily mutation is valid; authored dailies belong to QuestManager. WorldWeaver inspect adapter is still absent.

domains.planned_actions: conditional goal counter adjustment with explicit reward policy; inspect immutable receipts
domains.canonical_route: CommunityGoalManager.contributeOnce and durable completion outbox; ProfessionWeeklyGoalManager.add
domains.rationale: Do not forge natural source-event receipts. Player/source context must survive contribution and payout queues; generic counter editing may inadvertently complete treasury/season rewards.

domains.planned_actions: conditional lifecycle/membership/leadership controls and sandbox party-loot inspection
domains.canonical_route: GuildManager create/invite/accept/leave/kick/deposit; PartyManager invite/accept/leave/promote/disband
domains.rationale: External membership drift and shared treasury/assets require transaction checks. Personal loot and guild activity XP need influence-aware source propagation.

domains.inspect: council eligibility/votes, king state, treasury and legacy tax liability inspection
domains.planned_actions: conditional king/vote/tax/treasury changes and compensating actions
domains.canonical_route: CouncilManager civil-law policy; FactionTreasuryManager native treasury transactions; retired membership-tax producer remains retired
domains.rationale: PR #155 removes personal king withdrawal and retires membership-tax production. WorldWeaver must not reactivate the producer or erase remaining historical profile liability/receipts.

domains.inspect: Independent Infamy/Wanted/Exile/DARK Oath; Whisper exposure stage, witness/suspect evidence and consumed status, rite before/after receipt, return cooldown and hidden alias
domains.planned_actions: conditional legal-axis changes, exposure/cover, evidence inspection, rite recovery controls and hidden role mutation through async canonical services; never synthetic natural evidence
domains.canonical_route: PlayerProfileSinStore / PlayerProfileWhisperStore conditional FACTION transactions; manager runtime reconciliation; never blocking SinManager wrappers on region thread
domains.rationale: PR #155 replaces suspicion score and implicit DARK membership with distinct legal axes and durable evidence/rite state. Developer canonical mutations require expected-revision async APIs and observed-state recovery; no fake sightings, accusations, rites or reward receipts. PR #155 refresh 2a78 adds typed incident evidence, withdrawal with retained legal history/24h return cooldown, witnessed-candidate interruption, join/respawn grace, and chunk-owned sightline traversal. These must use actual native lifecycle/incident identity, never manufactured observations. Native Scene/rite callbacks retain Bukkit references and synchronous legal wrappers remain excluded from WorldWeaver owner-thread invocation; asynchronous revision-safe adapters and influence propagation are still required.

domains.planned_actions: start/stop exact-instance conflict and bounded participants/target controls
domains.canonical_route: RaidManager.startRaid/endRaid/joinRaid; WarWindowManager.forceStart/forceEnd; HonorDuelManager.challenge/accept; CombatTagManager
domains.rationale: SANDBOX conflict cannot grant kills, season points, treasury, loot or quest credit. Time-bound instance fences and combat-tag/protection invariants required.

domains.planned_actions: bounded modifier projection; conditional season points and lifecycle actions via canonical coordinator
domains.canonical_route: SeasonManager and PlayerProfileSeasonParticipationStore record/load/contributions/active; canonical FACTION profile transaction
domains.rationale: PR #155 adds a bounded persistent contribution authority tied to current faction join time. Inspect and semantic developer surfaces plus source integrity gates are required; SANDBOX must not create qualifying contribution receipts.

domains.planned_actions: bounded rehearsal/start/pause/resume/abort/checkpoint/gate controls through domain lifecycle
domains.canonical_route: PrologueManager durable state; PrologueFinaleManager; PrologueRuntime.worldAccess/encounters; reward commit chain
domains.rationale: Current Doom runtime is the Prologue/gate/territory/portal boundary, not a separate Doom engine. Fork forbidden for this lifecycle. Rehearsal alone does not prove all reward quarantine.

domains.planned_actions: bounded start/cancel and conditional course definitions
domains.canonical_route: ParkourManager.start/cancel/cancelForMobility/setStart/setFinish/remove
domains.rationale: Teleport/flight/velocity/SANDBOX influence must invalidate parkour credit and downstream quest completion, including post-projection quarantine.

domains.planned_actions: existing async moderation actions, revoke with new history, vanish refresh, report resolution
domains.canonical_route: ModerationManager.issueAsync/revokeAsync/setVanishedAsync; VanishManager refreshSubject; InvseeWriteCoordinator
domains.rationale: Vanish has no independent setter ledger: durable state is ModerationManager. No arbitrary offline inventory writes or punishment/history erasure; WW primary-dev check precedes all adapters.

domains.planned_actions: bounded AFK/sit/stand/intro replay/ferry transition
domains.canonical_route: AfkManager.toggleAfk; SitManager.sit/standUp/resetPlayer; IntroManager.play; FerryManager.ride
domains.rationale: Canonical mobility/cost paths and state cleanup must remain; SANDBOX teleport or cinematic cannot earn progression or parkour credit.

domains.planned_actions: bounded preference/preview/refresh/binding/sound actions through owned APIs
domains.canonical_route: HudManager snapshot/preference/editor API; NpcBindingManager.bind/unbind; BardManager.sing
domains.rationale: No permanent WorldWeaver HUD. Existing gameplay presentation surfaces can be inspected/manipulated without a second renderer or command wrapper; owner-thread GUI and NPC contracts apply.

domains.planned_actions: bounded conditional operator override/revert through ConfigManager; content inspection only
domains.canonical_route: ConfigManager.applyOverridesIfUnchanged/applyOverride/resetOverride; ConfigSnapshot
domains.rationale: No direct YAML editing. Restart-only canonical content is not runtime-mutated. A config-wide change with gameplay impact needs WORLD influence and explicit canonical arming.

domains.canonical_route: EventSpawnPointManager; EventSpawnGuard; canonical CityGuard/DarkUndead/Dungeon managers
domains.rationale: EventSpawner policies are shared infrastructure, not a replacement lifecycle; automatic spawns, dungeon payouts and natural DARK targeting need source identity/gates.
